NWS Detroit/Pontiac · 627 PM EST Thu Nov 5 2026

- Showers increase coverage across the area tonight leading to an 
active pattern that continues Friday and Friday night. 

- Temperatures return to a more typical range for early November but 
are much cooler than recent days. 

- Dry weather helps temperatures rise a few degrees above normal 
again during the weekend and early next week.

.AVIATION...

Strong absolute vorticity maximum will dig directly into Southeast 
Michigan between 06-15z Friday. Height falls and differential 
cyclonic vorticity advection is forecasted to result in an active 
low-midlevel frontogenesis axis directly over the forecast area 
sometime between 03-09z, resulting in an increasing coverage of 
rain. Maintained the inherited TEMPO for MVFR rain. This fgen will 
coincide with secondary cold front or dewpoint gradient that will 
result in another round of cold advection. Steepening lapse rates 
with saturation will result in MVFR or VFR stratocumulus Friday. 
Northwest wind Friday of 10 to 20 knots.
